messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for HIGH - LB backend targets flapping (route: inference-prod). PagerDuty ID PD-4821. Symptoms: burst of 502/504 from edge -> backend pool in us-west-2. Details: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-4821

pagerduty: Assigned to oncall-sre (primary) — escalation policy: infra-prod.

oncall-sre: ack'd. I'm on it. starting triage now. any confirmed customer impact? :eyes:

alex_dev: seeing spike in 5xx from rg-inference-backend target group. Logs: connection reset by peer and some read timeout entries. No deploys in last 24h.

maria_net: LB health checks show ~30% of targets Unhealthy intermittently. Health check failures are TCP-level, not application 200/500. Checking node-level logs for TLS/SNI mismatches.

katie_sre: grabbing dashboards — latency up, error budget burn ~7% over 10m. Reqs/sec steady but error rate spike.

oncall-sre: quick mitigation plan: 1) drain detected unhealthy nodes 2) scale backend pool + attach healthy spare 3) if still degraded, shift traffic weight to us-east-1. Doing (1) now.

oncall-sre: running command: ```infractl lb detach-target --tg rg-inference-backend --target i-0a1b2c3d```

incident-bot: Note: automated retry/backoff policy active for routed requests. Will attempt to redistribute traffic across healthy targets.

alex_dev: container logs on a few hosts show repeated process restarts with OOM killer entries and "connection reset by peer" at the same timestamps as health-check failures. Possible resource pressure.

maria_net: confirming SNI logs — a handful of connections show SNI "" (empty). Could be a malformed client or reverse proxy bug, but majority look normal. Not seeing DNS propagation issues right now (TTL ~300).

sam_pm: multiple customers reporting errors in inference endpoints. PM triage: ~25-35% of requests failing for some tenants, highest on real-time chat workloads. Marking customer-impacting.

katie_sre: I'm going to bump backend ASG desired capacity by +3 and attach spares to target group. If OOM is cause, new instances may be clean.

oncall-sre: started rolling restarts of 4 affected backend hosts (graceful drain -> restart). Will monitor error rate.

alex_dev: FYI I see an app memory leak trace in logs for service worker V2 — PID churning. Opening a quick patch but won't push into the mid-incident window unless necessary.

maria_net: I'm pre-authorizing partial traffic weight shift: adjusting global LB traffic weights to route 35% of traffic to us-east-1 while we stabilize us-west-2. Doing weight change now (will take ~60s to propagate).

oncall-sre: traffic weight change applied. Observability: errors dropping from 30% -> 12% within 3m. Good signal.

pagerduty: Escalation: PD-4821 escalated to L2 (katie_sre) due to sustained error rate above threshold.

katie_sre: L2 oncall here. continuing work — will validate memory profiles and keep restart rotation. If restarts don't fix, will do full replacement of affected AMI.

alex_dev: quick dump of failing stacktrace for context: ```RuntimeError: failed to accept connection
  at net/connection.c:124
  Caused by: OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space```

oncall-sre: after restarts + extra capacity + weight shift, 5xx down to baseline (~1-2%). Latency returning to normal. Marking mitigation as effective.

sam_pm: customers are seeing much better success rates. I'll update status page and send a short note to impacted tenants.

katie_sre: scheduling post-incident actions: 1) revert weight shift after full stability 2) rollout hotfix for memory leak in canary 3) increase LB health-check sensitivity and add additional alarms for OOM patterns.

oncall-sre: handing off monitoring to katie_sre in 20 minutes for full post-incident validation.

incident-bot: Automated update: PD-4821 status set to "mitigated". Please confirm when fully resolved.

oncall-sre: marking incident as mitigated. I'll wait 30m of steady metrics before resolving the PagerDuty incident.

katie_sre: acknowledged takeover. I'll run the memory profiler sweep and follow up with a postmortem owner.

sam_pm: noted. I'll coordinate customer comms and include ETA for detailed postmortem (24-48h).

alex_dev: added a temporary guard to restart worker loop on OOM to reduce repeated crash flapping while we deliver the patch.

oncall-sre: final note: no DNS TTL nor cert changes detected; root cause appears to be application memory leak causing node instability which manifested as LB target health flapping. Moving to postmortem tracking (ENG-RUNTIME). :memo: :tools:

katie_sre: closing actions assigned in JIRA: INF-7123 (hotfix), INF-7124 (LB alarm), INF-7125 (postmortem).

incident-bot: PD-4821 will be auto-resolved once owner closes the incident.

oncall-sre: handing off to katie_sre now. thanks team. :thumbsup:

sam_pm: adding this thread to the incident tracker and notifying affected customers.

katie_sre: will follow up with a short incident summary and timeline in #postmortems in ~24h.

pagerduty: Incident PD-4821 acknowledged by katie_sre and set to mitigation in progress.
